title: Run in a fresh container
description: Starts a new container from this app's image, with its env and secrets, runs the command once and shows its output. The live container is not touched.
hint: Run directly, without a shell. Quote an argument with spaces. For pipes or redirects, use sh -c "...".
truncated: Output was longer than the server keeps; only the last part is shown.
accessRule: One-off runs and scheduled jobs follow console exec access rules: running a command needs root access on this app and exec enabled for it.
